what: Qualcomm designs the Snapdragon processors and modems in most high-end Android phones, and licenses the patents behind mobile networks. It is expanding into cars, PCs and connected devices.
customers: Phone makers such as Samsung, Xiaomi and Apple, carmakers and device makers.
money: a small part of revenue but a large part of profit
royalties on phones that use its patents
moat: A leading modem and patent portfolio that nearly every phone maker must license.
